title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Production Licenses for Industrial Products of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated to ensure the quality and safety of important industrial products directly related to public safety, human health, and safety of life and property, to implement national industrial policies, and to promote the healthy and coordinated development of the socialist market economy.

Article 3 The catalog of industrial products subject to the production license system (hereinafter referred to as the Catalog) shall be formulated by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council, soliciting opinions from consumer associations and relevant product industry associations, and shall be submitted to the State Council for approval before being published to the public.
If the quality and safety of industrial products can be effectively ensured through consumers' self-judgment, enterprise self-discipline, and market competition, the production license system shall not be implemented.
If the quality and safety of industrial products can be effectively ensured through the certification and accreditation system, the production license system shall not be implemented.
The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council, jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council, shall timely evaluate, adjust, and gradually reduce the Catalog, and shall submit it to the State Council for approval before being published to the public.

Article 4 Any person who produces, sells, or uses products included in the Catalog in business activities within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall comply with these Regulations.
The import and export management of products included in the Catalog shall be implemented in accordance with laws, administrative regulations, and the relevant provisions of the State.

Article 5 No enterprise may produce products included in the Catalog without obtaining a production license. No unit or individual may sell or use in business activities products included in the Catalog for which a production license has not been obtained.

Article 6 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall be responsible for the unified administration of industrial product production licenses nationwide in accordance with these Regulations, and the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level shall be responsible for the administration of industrial product production licenses within their respective administrative regions.
For industrial products subject to the industrial product production license system, the State shall unify the Catalog, unify the review requirements, unify the certificate markings, and unify the supervision and administration.
Article 7 The administration of industrial product production licenses shall follow the principles of being scientific and fair, open and transparent, procedurally lawful, convenient and efficient.

Article 8 The competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level and their personnel, inspection institutions, and inspection personnel shall have the obligation to keep confidential any State secrets and trade secrets that come to their knowledge.

Article 10 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall, in accordance with the conditions specified in Article 9 of these Regulations and based on the different characteristics of industrial products, formulate and publish the specific requirements for obtaining production licenses for products included in the Catalog; if special provisions need to be made for the specific requirements for production licenses for products included in the Catalog, they shall be formulated and published jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council.
When formulating the specific requirements for production licenses for products included in the Catalog, opinions shall be solicited from consumer associations and relevant product industry associations.

Article 11 An enterprise producing products included in the Catalog shall apply to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where the enterprise is located to obtain a production license.
If a product that an enterprise is already producing is included in the Catalog, the enterprise shall apply to obtain a production license within the time limit prescribed by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council.
An enterprise's application may be submitted by letter, telegram, telex, fax, electronic data interchange, or email.

Article 12 After receiving an enterprise's application, the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall handle it in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 13 The competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government and any other unit shall not impose additional conditions to restrict an enterprise from applying for a production license.

Article 14 After accepting an enterprise's application, the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall organize an examination of the enterprise. If, in accordance with the specific requirements for production licenses for products included in the Catalog, the examination of the enterprise shall be organized by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council, the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, within five days from the date of accepting the application, submit all the application materials to the competent department under the State Council.
The examination of the enterprise includes on-site verification of the enterprise and inspection of the products.

Article 15 For on-site verification of an enterprise, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall assign two to four verification personnel, and the enterprise shall cooperate.

Article 16 Verification personnel shall only engage in corresponding verification work after passing the examination organized by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and obtaining a verification personnel certificate.

Article 17 Verification personnel shall conduct on-site verification of an enterprise in accordance with the conditions specified in Article 9 of these Regulations and the specific requirements for production licenses for products included in the Catalog.
When conducting on-site verification of an enterprise, verification personnel shall not make things difficult for the enterprise, shall not extort or accept property from the enterprise, and shall not seek other improper benefits.

Article 18 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall inform the enterprise in writing of the results of the on-site verification within 30 days from the date of accepting the application. If the verification is not passed, the reasons shall be stated.

Article 19 If an enterprise passes the on-site verification, it shall promptly undergo product inspection. If sample delivery inspection is required, the verification personnel shall seal the samples and inform the enterprise to deliver the samples to an inspection institution with corresponding qualifications within seven days. If on-site inspection is required, the verification personnel shall notify the inspection institution to conduct on-site inspection.

Article 20 Inspection institutions shall conduct product inspection in accordance with relevant national standards and requirements and complete the inspection work within the prescribed time limit.
Inspection institutions and inspection personnel shall issue inspection reports objectively, impartially, and promptly. After the inspection personnel have signed the inspection report, the person in charge of the inspection institution shall countersign it. Inspection institutions and inspection personnel shall be responsible for the inspection report.

Article 21 When conducting product inspection, inspection institutions and inspection personnel shall follow the principles of good faith and convenience for enterprises, provide reliable and convenient inspection services to enterprises, and shall not delay or make things difficult for enterprises.

Article 22 Inspection institutions and inspection personnel shall not engage in production or sales activities related to the products included in the Catalog that they inspect, and shall not recommend, supervise the manufacture or sale of such products in their own name.

Article 23 If the examination of an enterprise is organized by the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, the said department shall, after completing the examination, submit the examination opinions and all application materials to the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council.

Article 24 Within 60 days from the date of accepting an enterprise's application, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall make a decision on whether to grant the license. If a decision to grant the license is made, the competent department under the State Council shall issue an industrial product production license certificate (hereinafter referred to as the License Certificate) to the enterprise within 10 days from the date of making the decision; if a decision not to grant the license is made, the competent department under the State Council shall notify the enterprise in writing and state the reasons.
The time required for an inspection institution to conduct product inspection shall not be included in the time limit specified in the preceding paragraph.
The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall promptly notify the relevant departments, such as the development and reform department under the State Council and the health department under the State Council, of the decisions to grant licenses for relevant products.

Article 25 The term of validity of a production license shall be five years; however, the term of validity of a production license for a food processing enterprise shall be three years. If an enterprise continues production after the expiration of the term of validity of its production license, it shall submit an application for renewal to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where it is located six months before the expiration of the term. The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall examine the enterprise in accordance with the procedures prescribed in these Regulations.

Article 26 If, within the term of validity of a production license, the relevant standards or requirements for the product change, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may re-organize verification and inspection in accordance with these Regulations.
If, within the term of validity of a production license, the production conditions, inspection means, production technology or processes of an enterprise change, the enterprise shall promptly apply to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where it is located, and the competent department under the State Council or the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall re-organize verification and inspection in accordance with these Regulations.

Article 27 If the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council considers that a major licensing matter involving the public interest requires a hearing, it shall make a public announcement and hold a hearing.
The decisions to grant licenses made by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall be published to the public.
The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall promptly file the relevant materials concerning the handling of production licenses, and the public shall have the right to access them.

Article 28 The License Certificate shall consist of an original and a duplicate. The License Certificate shall state the enterprise's name and domicile, production address, product name, certificate number, date of issuance, term of validity, and other relevant contents.
The format of the License Certificate shall be prescribed by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council.

Article 29 If the name of an enterprise changes, the enterprise shall promptly apply to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where it is located to undergo the modification formalities.

Article 30 An enterprise shall properly keep its License Certificate. If the License Certificate is lost or damaged, the enterprise shall apply for a replacement. The competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where the enterprise is located shall promptly accept the application and handle the replacement formalities.

Article 31 If, within the term of validity of a production license, an enterprise no longer engages in the production of products included in the Catalog, it shall undergo the cancellation formalities for the production license. If the enterprise fails to undergo the cancellation formalities, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall cancel its production license and make a public announcement.
Article 32 The mark and pattern of the production license shall be prescribed and published by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council.

Article 33 An enterprise must mark the production license mark and number on its products or on the packaging or instruction manuals.
For unpackaged food and other unpackaged products on which marking the mark is difficult due to the product's characteristics, the production license mark and number may not be marked.
Article 34 An enterprise that sells or uses products included in the Catalog in business activities shall inspect the production license mark and number.

Article 35 No unit or individual may forge or alter License Certificates, production license marks, or numbers. An enterprise that has obtained a production license shall not lease, lend, or otherwise transfer its License Certificate or production license mark.

Article 36 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level shall, in accordance with these Regulations, be responsible for supervising and inspecting the relevant activities of enterprises producing products included in the Catalog, as well as verification personnel, inspection institutions, and their inspection personnel.
The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall supervise the production license administration work of the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level.

Article 38 An enterprise shall ensure that its product quality is consistently up to standard and shall submit reports to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government on a regular basis. The enterprise shall be responsible for the truthfulness of the reports.

Article 39 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level shall conduct regular or unscheduled supervision and inspection of enterprises. If product inspection is necessary, it shall be conducted in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Product Quality Law of the People's Republic of China.
When conducting supervision and inspection or product inspection, at least two staff members shall participate and shall present valid identification.

Article 40 When conducting supervision and inspection of enterprises, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level shall not hinder the normal production and business operations of enterprises, and shall not extort or accept property from enterprises or seek other benefits.

Article 41 When conducting supervision and inspection of enterprises according to law, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level shall record the circumstances and results of the supervision and inspection, and the records shall be signed by the supervision and inspection personnel before being filed. The public shall have the right to access the supervision and inspection records.

Article 42 The competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall, through methods such as reviewing inspection reports and comparing inspection conclusions, supervise and inspect whether the inspection process and inspection reports of inspection institutions are objective, impartial, and timely.

Article 43 If verification personnel, inspection institutions, or their inspection personnel make things difficult for an enterprise, the enterprise shall have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level. Upon receiving a complaint, the competent department under the State Council or the competent departments at or above the county level shall promptly investigate and handle it.

Article 44 Any unit or individual shall have the right to report any violation of these Regulations to the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council or the competent departments of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level. Upon receiving a report, the competent department under the State Council or the competent departments at or above the county level shall promptly investigate and handle it, and shall keep the reporter confidential.

Article 45 If an enterprise produces products included in the Catalog without applying for and obtaining a production license in accordance with these Regulations, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall order it to cease production, confiscate the illegally produced products, and impose a fine of not less than the value but not more than three times the value of the illegally produced products; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 46 If an enterprise that has obtained a production license has changes in its production conditions, inspection means, production technology, or processes, and fails to undergo re-examination formalities in accordance with these Regulations, it shall be ordered to cease production and sales, the illegally produced and sold products shall be confiscated, and it shall be required to undergo the relevant formalities within a specified time limit; if it still fails to do so upon expiration of the time limit, a fine of not more than three times the value of the illegally produced and sold products (including products already sold and unsold, the same below) shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
If an enterprise that has obtained a production license has a change in its name and fails to undergo the modification formalities in accordance with these Regulations, it shall be ordered to undergo the relevant formalities within a specified time limit; if it still fails to do so upon expiration of the time limit, it shall be ordered to cease production and sales, the illegally produced and sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than the value of the illegally produced and sold products shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated.

Article 47 If an enterprise that has obtained a production license fails to mark the production license mark and number on its products, packaging, or instruction manuals in accordance with these Regulations, it shall be ordered to make corrections within a specified time limit; if it still fails to make corrections upon expiration of the time limit, a fine of not more than 30 percent of the value of the illegally produced and sold products shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the production license shall be revoked.

Article 48 If any person sells or uses in business activities products included in the Catalog for which a production license has not been obtained, such person shall be ordered to make corrections, and a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 49 If an enterprise that has obtained a production license leases, lends, or transfers its License Certificate, production license mark, or number, it shall be ordered to make corrections within a specified time limit, and a fine of not more than 200,000 yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the production license shall be revoked. If any person illegally accepts and uses a License Certificate, production license mark, or number provided by another, such person shall be ordered to cease production and sales, the illegally produced and sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than the value but not more than three times the value of the illegally produced and sold products shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 50 If any person, without authorization, uses, exchanges, transfers, or damages sealed-up or seized property, such person shall be ordered to make corrections, and a fine of not less than 5 percent but not more than 20 percent of the value of the property that was used, exchanged, transferred, or damaged shall be imposed; if such person refuses to make corrections, a fine of not less than one time but not more than three times the value of the property that was used, exchanged, transferred, or damaged shall be imposed.

Article 51 If any person forges or alters a License Certificate, production license mark, or number, such person shall be ordered to make corrections, the illegally produced and sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than the value but not more than three times the value of the illegally produced and sold products shall be imposed; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 52 If an enterprise obtains a production license by fraudulent, bribery, or other improper means, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall impose a fine of not more than 200,000 yuan and handle the matter in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 53 If an enterprise that has obtained a production license fails to submit reports on a regular basis to the competent department of industrial product production licenses of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in accordance with these Regulations, the competent department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall order it to make corrections within a specified time limit.

Article 54 If a product for which a production license has been obtained fails a national supervision and inspection of product quality or a provincial supervision and inspection, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall order the enterprise to make corrections within a specified time limit; if the product still fails re-inspection upon expiration of the time limit, the production license shall be revoked.
Article 55 If an enterprise's production license is revoked, it shall not apply again for a production license for the same product included in the Catalog within three years.

Article 56 If an inspection institution undertaking the inspection work of licensed products forges inspection conclusions or issues false certificates, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall order it to make corrections, impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan on the institution, and impose a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan on the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible personnel; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, its inspection qualification shall be revoked; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 57 If an inspection institution or inspection personnel engages in production or sales activities related to the products included in the Catalog that it inspects, or recommends or supervises the manufacture or sale of such products in its own name, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall impose a fine of not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan; if there is illegal income, the illegal income shall be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, its inspection qualification shall be revoked.

Article 58 If an inspection institution or inspection personnel makes things difficult for an enterprise by using its inspection work, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall order it to make corrections; if it refuses to make corrections, its inspection qualification shall be revoked.

Article 59 If a competent department of industrial product production licenses at or above the county level, in violation of these Regulations, establishes a production license for industrial products other than those included in the Catalog, the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council shall order it to make corrections or shall revoke it according to law.

Article 61 If a staff member of a competent department of industrial product production licenses, while handling industrial product production licenses or conducting supervision and inspection, extorts or accepts property from others or seeks other benefits, if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if a crime is not constituted, administrative sanctions shall be imposed according to law.

Article 63 If a competent department of industrial product production licenses illegally implements a license and causes damage to the lawful rights and interests of a party, it shall pay compensation in accordance with the provisions of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 64 If a competent department of industrial product production licenses fails to perform its supervision duties according to law or performs supervision ineffectively, causing serious consequences, its superior administrative organ or supervisory organ shall order it to make corrections, and administrative sanctions shall be imposed on the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible personnel according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 65 The administrative penalty of revoking a production license as prescribed in these Regulations shall be decided by the competent department of industrial product production licenses. The competent department of industrial product production licenses shall promptly notify the relevant departments, such as the development and reform department and the health department, of the administrative penalty decision to revoke the production license for the relevant product.
If laws or administrative regulations have other provisions on the organs exercising the power of administrative penalty, those provisions shall prevail.
Article 66 If laws or administrative regulations have other provisions on the administration of industrial products, those provisions shall prevail.

Article 67 The charging items for handling industrial product production licenses by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council and the competent departments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the finance department and the pricing department under the State Council; the charging standards for industrial product production licenses shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the pricing department and the finance department under the State Council, and shall be open and transparent; all fees collected must be turned over to the State treasury in full, and shall not be withheld, misappropriated, privately divided, or disguisedly privately divided. The finance department shall not refund or disguisedly refund the fees collected to them in any form.

Article 68 When necessary, the competent departments of industrial product production licenses of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government may be responsible for the examination and issuance of production licenses for some products included in the Catalog, and the specific measures shall be separately formulated by the competent department of industrial product production licenses under the State Council.
Article 69 If an individual industrial or commercial household produces or sells products included in the Catalog, the provisions of these Regulations shall apply.

Article 70 These Regulations shall come into force as of September 1, 2005. The Interim Regulations on Industrial Product Production Licenses promulgated by the State Council on April 7, 1984 shall be abolished simultaneously.
